rng: numpy.random.default_rng / PCG64; trial_seed as stored in experiments.py
noise: Independent Gaussian noise per point/component, std = ratio * clean component RMS

lasso.normalization: Z=G/column_RMS, y=b/response_RMS; no centering, no extra intercept
lasso.selection: matrix-2-norm OLS projection difference / OLS projection norm + nonzero fraction; smallest ratio breaks ties
lasso.coefficients: Penalized coefficients, restored to physical units; no OLS support refit
lasso.support: Exact solver zeros; no coefficient cutoff
lasso.solver: scikit-learn LARS Gram path; primal active-set polishing first, then coordinate descent fallback and final polishing if KKT error exceeds 1e-7*alpha_max
lasso.validation: Every candidate must satisfy max coordinate KKT violation / alpha_max <= 1e-7
lasso.inputs: Weak G and b only; no true coefficients, support or clean observations

selection_rule: LASSO penalized path / WSINDy projection-support loss

preprocessing.noise_estimation: Sixth differences on opposite parity time subgrid only; max across components
preprocessing.window: debiasing_study.rule_size, rounded up to odd >= 3, capped by 2m+1 per axis
preprocessing.description: Section 5 polynomial linearization `f(pilot) + grad(f)(pilot) dot (U-pilot)`, with raw U on the LHS and in linear columns. Split is always time2. For each evaluation time parity, both the noise estimate and the pilot use only the opposite parity. Sixth differences estimate noise on that training time subgrid; the largest estimate across components selects a common box window using the study's volume rule, prior 0.01, rounded up to odd and at least 3. Spatial extension is periodic; time is reflected. All original weak rows, library terms and benchmark regression/scaling settings are retained. Physical coefficients are restored before scoring. No clean error or true support selects the window. This pooled cross-fit benchmark does not assert the single-pilot conditional Gaussian theorem for the pooled regression. Ratios 0, 0.2, 0.5, 0.75, 1; 100 paired trials each.
